verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the whole original into the middle of the strip: the 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' headline and the S-A-L-E circles are microscopic and can't be read, and the yellow either side of them is dead space. B makes the headline readable on the left, but SALE is broken: the S and the A-L-E letters have been pulled out of their circles, which now stand empty and stacked in the middle, and lantern and cloud line-art collides with the letters, so the hierarchy and reading order fall apart.
